content.title: About
content.content: Fruit flavored water beverage is a non‑alcoholic drink made by adding natural or artificial flavorings to pure drinking water. The beverage contains no sugar, calories, or caffeine, yet delivers a bright fruit taste that makes it popular among both children and adults looking for a refreshing, light option.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fruit flavored water is often used as an alternative to sweet carbonated sodas.
Flavorings can be derived from real fruit juice, but most commercial products use concentrated extracts.
Some brands fortify the drink with vitamin C (ascorbic acid) to enhance taste and extend shelf life.
The beverage is available in both sparkling and still versions.
In many markets it is sold in 0.5 L and 1.5 L bottles.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Like plain water, the drink helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Low Calorie Content
items.content: The absence of sugar makes it suitable for calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Vitamin C (in some variants)
items.content: Added vitamin C supports the immune system and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Caffeine‑Free
items.content: Ideal for children and individuals avoiding stimulants.

items.title: Easy on the Stomach
items.content: Most variants have low acidity, which is gentle on the digestive tract.

items.title: Allergy to Flavorings
items.content: Some people may experience allergic reactions to artificial flavorings or added additives.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Certain versions can be slightly acidic, potentially affecting tooth enamel with frequent consumption.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Preservatives used to extend shelf life may not be suitable for individuals with sensitivities.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Serve chilled, optionally with ice or a slice of fresh fruit to boost flavor. It works well as a standalone refresher or as a base for non‑alcoholic cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
